A '''Viper probe droid''' served [[Moff]] [[Gideon]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|23}}</ref> the [[droid]] was present on [[Coruscant]] to conduct a report between Gideon and [[New Republic Amnesty Program|Amnesty officer]] and [[spy]] [[Elia Kane]].<ref name="Chapter 23: The Spies" />
